name: CSS Mediator
note: R13.9, Captain's Module C2 SSD p.36. Like the CA, the sheet draws the fully refitted ship (145) and prices each refit as a deduction, so the hull here is the Y160 original: six phaser-1s and two plasma-G, 145 - 4 - 10 - 8 = 123. NO PPD — the pulsar device is a heavy-hull weapon and this ship has no refit line for one, which is the clearest difference from the Star Cruiser. Its plasma-S sit on the CENTRELINE at FP rather than in the wings at LP/RP, and it carries four rear-firing plasma-F instead of six. The Y180 Sabot refit (+8) is absent for the same reason as the CA's: FP11.0 lives in Module R10, out of scope. Probe AMMO (5 rounds) is not modelled — auxiliary.probes is the launcher count.

refits.name: PH-3 refit
refits.label: PH-3
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PH-3 REFIT, DELETE ALL PHASER-3s. Four here, against the CA's six.

refits.name: PL-S refit
refits.label: Plasma-S
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-S REFIT, PLASMA-S TORPEDOES 'A' AND 'B' ARE PLASMA-G TORPEDOES. A conversion, scoped to those two designators so it cannot reach the plasma-F the next refit adds, whatever order the two are ticked in.

refits.name: PL-F refit
refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE ALL PLASMA-F TORPEDOES. R13.1C's rear-firing torpedoes, flagged iscRearFiring — see the Star Cruiser's note for what that anchors. Four here, two a side, against the CA's six.
